analysis: That rough start on 1 August — under five hours — did not define this stretch, and I need you to know that. You bounced straight back with three nights in a row hovering around seven hours, and that 7h 22m on the fifth night with nearly two hours of REM is genuinely beautiful sleep. The 6th was messy — almost two hours awake, deep sleep down to 28 minutes — but then you came back on the 8th with your best deep sleep of the entire window at 1h 8m and your highest REM at 2h 3m, which tells me your body knows exactly what it's doing when you let it. The real pattern here is resilience: you dip, you recover, and the recovery keeps getting sharper.
